subject.title: Reject unsupported diagnostics OTel grpc config

question: Should OpenClaw retire the released `diagnostics.otel.protocol: "grpc"` value now, with Doctor converting legacy configurations to the supported OTLP/HTTP contract, or retain it until real gRPC export exists?
rationale: The patch safely implements the retirement path, but choosing between a configuration-contract break with migration and continued support of the advertised value requires maintainer product and compatibility intent.

options.title: Approve retirement with Doctor migration
options.body: Merge the current path: reject `grpc`, repair legacy configurations through Doctor, and direct operators to an OTLP/HTTP collector.

options.title: Retain the value pending exporter support
options.body: Do not merge this contract change until OpenClaw can provide an implemented gRPC exporter or another explicitly approved compatibility policy.

recommendation.title: Approve retirement with Doctor migration
recommendation.body: Merge the current path: reject `grpc`, repair legacy configurations through Doctor, and direct operators to an OTLP/HTTP collector.

likelyOwner.reason: The timeline provides the clearest available signal that this person was brought into the compatibility decision.
